games.name: Code Lab
games.maxBoard: C3 School lists/functions and Deep Water nested loops; 4 touch slots; Predict outputs and engine trace
games.firstAction: Start L1 Predict, choose an output and Check. After a correct prediction tap Next program to enter Build; tap a blank then a value and Run. Test a miss, Undo, Look/One step/Clear and quit/resume. After each successful check tap Next program, including after the fourth program to reach the quiet ending
games.challengeSteps: Map → School → Code Lab → Challenge; choose teaching and hardest tiers without stars. Start explicitly, make a wrong Run, edit (old trace must disappear), Undo (old checked trace returns; Run disabled), try a different draft, use Help, quit/resume, finish and reopen. Inspect Earlier/Next/Last line after long and short checked traces. On a Clean dare with no existing mark, replay, select Clear and finish; verify the finish is saved and no Clean mark is awarded. Separately finish an unassisted replay as a positive control; verify the Clean mark is awarded and never decreases. Fill paused spaces and attempt another Start; cancel and retain every draft.
